calculus-section-14-7-3-project-applied-: The written assessment must tie assumptions to the actual observed container; this check covers the mathematical sensitivity, not the full discussion.
calculus-section-14-7-4-project-applied-: The user-selected dumpster dimensions and construction details determine the numeric savings; the checker does not invent a field survey.
calculus-section-14-7-1-project-discover: Differentiate the Taylor polynomial and set each displacement to0; constant quadratic coefficients recover the Hessian.
calculus-section-14-7-4-project-discover: For a≠0, completing the square exposes the signs of both quadratic directions. If a=0 and D<0, b≠0 and the xy term still gives a saddle.
calculus-section-14-7-5-project-discover: At the critical point, constant and linear terms vanish. The quadratic remainder controls local signs when the Hessian is nondegenerate.
